correctness.rationale: PASS: For β>1 and irrational φ/π where φ=arccos(1/β), normalize b,c by β^n and a by α^n, α=sqrt(β²−1). Exact EGF relations G(w)=exp(qw)F(pw), H(w)=exp(qw)F(−pw) (p=α/β,q=1/β). On third-harmonic rays Bouthat Lemma 4.2 gives e^(−t)G(te^(±3iφ))→0 and analog for H. Poisson angular phase equidistribution for irrational φ/π follows from Fourier characteristic exp(t(e^(ikφ)−1))→0 for every nonzero k. With λ=[3−4sin²(π/9)]⁻¹, g=cosθ+λcos3θ, exact mean |g|=J=2/π(2cos(π/9)−1). Nonreal second harmonic vanishes; first-harmonic amplitude ≤J times coefficient limsup. Bouthat Lemmas 5.1 (sector interpolation) and 3.2 (Cauchy saddle arcs) yield coefficient constant 2J=4/π(2cosπ/9−1)≈1.119668<2/√3. Independently verified g zero, antiderivative, numeric constant and transform normalizations; finite quadrature is corroborative only.
